change_summary: Skip re-sending system messages after the first turn to save tokens.
reason_for_change: System + policy messages (~150–200 tokens) were sent every turn; omitting them after turn 0 lowers per-turn prompt length without impacting task success because the model already retains that context.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: accepted: all 2 proxy runs improved mean cost per task within guardrails
hypothesis: Include system messages (policy + instructions) only on the very first generation call; omit them from subsequent build_messages invocations.
